description: T-5107 search candidate, fresh cells (decision 0188 R4.2; Taskei P559210060): BETA.INV, F.INV, F.INV.RT, FINV and BETAINV on the worksheet kernels, and the beta cdf those searches run on (BETA.DIST, F.DIST, F.DIST.RT, BINOM.DIST cumulative), every argument a literal. Drawn from a seeded pool after the candidate was frozen (docs/research/t5107-fin-val4/fresh_pool.py); no cell here was read to shape it. Sheet W is the sweep: the first 40 formulas of each of the pool's eight groups, log-uniform over each group's domain, taken before either engine's value was looked at. Sheet D is aimed: the first 25 later formulas of each group on which the engine before the change and the engine with it differ. Column A is the group: CS the beta cdf at both shapes in (1, 8]; CL at shapes up to 1000; FC the F cdf and its right tail; BN the binomial cdf; BI BETA.INV; FI F.INV; FR F.INV.RT; LV the legacy FINV and BETAINV. Frozen engine values, before and with the change: docs/research/t5107-fin-val4/search-fresh-predictions.tsv (hypotheses, NOT expected values). Precision!B2:B4 must retain 0.9999999999999998, 1, 1.0000000000000002; C2:C4 must be -1,0,1.
